card.name: Dis- at start of section words
card.fires_on: Fires on the word 'Dis' beginning discontinue/disposal words, and on 'and'/'or' joining class lists such as 'Class IA and III'. Also seen on 'adverse' after 'serious' in warnings.

modes.label: Dis- starting a word
modes.description: The piece 'Dis' that begins discontinuation or disposal headings and sentences.
modes.example: 2.4 Drug<< Dis>>continuation If therapy needs to be discontinued

modes.label: Joiner in class lists
modes.description: 'and' or 'or' linking antiarrhythmic classes or items in a drug list.
modes.example: Drugs known to prolong QT interval (e.g., Class IA<< and>> Class III antiarrhythmic agents).

card.plain: It marks a spot where a word is just starting or a list item is about to follow, mostly in drug-label warnings and interaction lists.
